fixed_q_slope.scope: Fixed representative q, two separated correlators with independent amplitudes and common slope. No correction term or critical-q propagation; not the asymptotic CFT dimension or a systematic bound.

scope: Existing retained regular checkpoints only. R and m2 use full scalar histories in shared time blocks when scalar_mode=dense_bins. R and log ensemble G are interpolated directly. Unique supported crossings required; root tails never clipped or branch-selected. Finite-pair Delta differs from asymptotic CFT dimension; no calibrated systematic error. Spatial sites/axes not independent samples; short chain block counts limit error assessment.
